Rich Text

Rich Text block (KB-D-080): rich text with block styles (alignment, text size, lead paragraph, colour, columns, width) and the full editor toolbar; and the built-in Text component's toolbar.

Components: rich-text, text.

  • Rich Text: text size, lead paragraph and colour
  • Rich Text: toolbar content
  • Rich Text: Additional tab
